title: Titan's 120‑km Methane River Unveiled by Cassini
description: Cassini’s radar revealed a river‑like channel of liquid methane on Titan, showing real‑world alien hydrology. Follow for daily science!

scenes.text: Titan's 120‑km methane river was spotted by Cassini
Radar imaging showed a narrow, winding channel near Titan’s north pole
scenes.label: NARROW POLAR CHANNEL

scenes.text: The feature stretches roughly 120 kilometers, comparable to the length of Manhattan
scenes.label: 120‑KM LENGTH

scenes.text: Seasonal changes cause the river to dry and refill, indicating a dynamic methane cycle
scenes.label: SEASONAL FLOW VARIATIO

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.
